environment.python_source: system /usr/bin/python3 in the approved Ubuntu-22.04 WSL2 distro
environment.venv_strategy: python3 -m venv --without-pip; bootstrap pip via https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py (network, dependency-prep phase only); pip install pinned pytest

licensing.summary: MIT license (Copyright 2017-2019 James Koppel). legal_notes.txt documents the Quixey-bankruptcy IP situation and creator Liron Shapira's explicit written consent to use the dataset. Supports local, non-redistributed research execution.

test_data.note: The buggy python_programs/gcd.py computes gcd(a % b, b); b never changes across recursive calls, so only the trivial b==0 case ([17, 0] -> 17) passes on the buggy baseline and every other case recurses to RecursionError. This is real upstream dataset behavior, not synthesized or curated.

unresolved_assumptions: Only 1 of 6 gcd parametrized cases passes on the buggy baseline, so tests.pass_to_pass has exactly 1 entry under the schema's relaxed >=1 floor (agentic_debugger/evaluation/task_schema.py, lowered from >=2 specifically to accommodate this real external-dataset shape without fabricating a second passing node).

conftest.py, python_testcases/load_testdata.py, and json_testcases/gcd.json are non-target support files required for pytest collection; they are acquired as part of the whole pinned repository rather than individually curated.

Python 3.10.12 (the system interpreter already present in the approved Ubuntu-22.04 WSL distro) is used because QuixBugs' README does not pin an exact Python version; pytest is pinned to 7.4.4 and both are recorded in the environment fingerprint.

Exact resource-profile byte/second values were sized empirically against the real gcd/pytest workload (peak RSS ~27MB, wall time <0.1s) and are additionally live self-tested for enforcement immediately before the real smoke runs; they are not metadata-only claims.
